instances.docstring: Emit a plus label above the reference, a centre note alongside it, and that value below.
Yield a top mark above the benchmark, a match cue alongside it, and that value below.
Yield a top mark above the datum, a level flag alongside it, and that value below.
Forward the input as-is while it keeps below the ceiling, and bounds it there after that point.
Pass the input as-is while it holds under the cap, and bounds it there after that point.
Carry the input as-is while it rests below the ceiling, and bounds it there when it exceeds.
Forward the input as-is while it keeps above the floor, and bounds it there under that point.
Pass the input as-is while it holds over the ground level, and bounds it there under that point.
Carry the input as-is while it rests above the floor, and bounds it there when it falls short.
Return the initial group when the value drops under the cut line, and the alternative one for the remaining values.
Emit the bottom rank when the value falls below the boundary, and the greater one past that point.
Hand back the junior class when the value dips below the cutoff, and the larger one in every other case.
Yield a dominant figure when one input tops the other, and a spare one in the remaining case.
Derive a greater figure when one input is larger than the other, and a weaker one otherwise.
Output a top reward when one input exceeds the other, and a losing one otherwise.
Supply a constant value while the toggle stays disabled, and once active a weighted, offset version of it.
Produce a default value while the gate stays down, and if it is raised a scaled, shifted form of it.
Produce a safe value while the selector stays clear, and on the active path a scaled, shifted form of it.
Look up an assigned tag for either known key, and the reserve input for anything else.
Look up a preset output for any listed known key, and the secondary input for anything else.
Emit a dedicated output for each known key, and the spare input for anything else.
Return the spread of the input from the baseline, lifted by an uniform amount.
Derive the spread of the input from the midline, offset upward by a constant amount.
Emit the reflected size of the input from the centre, increased by a set amount.
Return a set value for values that land in the accepted range, and the value itself beyond the bounds.
Yield a flag figure for values that land in the allowed interval, and the value itself beyond the bounds.
Emit an in-range token for values that stay within the valid window, and the value itself otherwise.
Emit the input intact when it lies inside the pair of bounds together, and the spare input for out-of-band inputs.
Emit the input as given when it is bounded by the two bounds together, and the alternative input for out-of-band inputs.
Yield the input verbatim when it falls within both bounds together, and the alternative input otherwise.
Return the top reading above the threshold and the fallback one below it.
Yield the first reading above the dividing line and the fallback one below it.
Yield the first result above the cutoff and the smaller one below it.
Return a raised flag above zero, the minus one below, and a flat reading right at the centre.
Signal a raised flag above zero, the dropped one below, and a centred code at the origin.
Emit a positive flag above zero, the dropped one below, and a null mark for a flat input.
Yield a weighted score from the text length once it passes the ceiling, and a constant value below that point.
Report a stretched score from the text length once it passes the ceiling, and a constant value for the brief case.
Emit an amplified score from the text length once it overruns the cap, and a set value otherwise.
Supply the alternative input when the first stays beneath the base level, and in every other case a rescaled mix of it.
Produce the backup input when the first lies below the lower limit, and above that point a scaled, shifted form of it.
Yield the spare input when the first sits short of the floor, and for the remaining inputs a scaled, shifted form of it.
Emit the secondary input when the main input escapes one bound, and the input once inside.
Emit the standby input when the core input violates a single bound, and the input once inside.
Yield the alternative input when the first input slips past a defined bound, and the input otherwise.
